svg.title: EP2 C2 AREA 13
svg.desc: Spaceship uses parallel spawn routes. Each group handles its own mechanisms and regroups as soon as the gate opens. Use the source-numbered rooms as the route order; colored symbols identify switches, barriers, warps and fixed pickups.
